sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Happy Helloween is the core gameplay mechanic of catching candies. The game starts with a slow pace and gradually increases in speed as you progress through the levels.

The controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for players of all ages to pick up and play. The gameplay is fast-paced and requires quick reflexes and timing to catch the candies. Players must anticipate where the candies will fall and react quickly to catch them. The game also features obstacles that will try to hinder your progress, such as bugs, spiders, and other Halloween-themed creatures.

As you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, and new obstacles are introduced to make it even more difficult. But don't worry, the game also provides power-ups and special abilities that can be used to help you survive the Halloween night.
